online.text: How many players are in the server now, out of the most it accepts. Press it to open the player list.
online.example: 10 / 64 means 10 are in and there is room for 64

kpi.uptime: How long the server has been running since its last start or restart. It goes back to zero after every restart; the start time is under it.
kpi.bans: Bans that have not ended yet, timed and permanent. Press it to see the list and lift any of them.
kpi.blocks: Characters that are suspended: the owner can still join the server but cannot play that character. Press it to see them.
kpi.scripts: How many of the server's scripts are running. A stopped script means its feature may not work for players. Press it to open Resources.

dashboard.attention: Players who may need you now: dead, hunger or thirst under 20, badly hurt, frozen or with a weak connection. Press a row to open their file.

filter.all: Shows everyone on the list, whatever the reason. The number beside each choice says how many players it has.
filter.dead: Only players who are dead and waiting for a revive. Revive them with the Revive button on their row.
filter.low: Only players whose hunger or thirst is under 20 of 100. Under the damage limit in the HUD settings (15 unless changed) their health starts dropping.
filter.hurt: Only living players whose health is under 20%. One more hit could kill them.
filter.frozen: Only players who are frozen in place. Remember to unfreeze them when you are done.
filter.ping: Only players with a weak connection, a ping of 200 ms or more. They may lag or drop; it usually comes from their own internet.

col.player: The character name and the fixed citizen ID, then the session number (#). Press the row to open the player's file.
col.reason: Why the player is listed: dead, low needs with the numbers, hurt, frozen or high ping.
col.action: The quickest fix in one press. Actions follow your permissions; a locked one explains why it is unavailable.

when.text: When it happened, counted back from now.

col.admin: The staff member who did it, as saved in the admin log.
col.what: What happened and to whom in a few words, with the line as the server kept it under it (the reason or the amount). Press the line to open the player or character.

revive.text: Brings the dead player back to life on the spot with full health. They notice at once, and it is written in the admin log.

refill.text: Fills the player's hunger and thirst to 100. They see it on their status bars at once.
refill.undo: Not needed: hunger and thirst drop again over time

heal.text: Restores the living player's health to full. They notice at once.

unfreeze.text: Unfreezes the player so they can move again.
unfreeze.undo: Yes, freeze them again from their file

dashboard.open: Opens the player's file on the Players page, with every action: travel, health, money, items and moderation.
dashboard.world: Changes the weather and time for every player at once and sends an announcement everyone sees. The full tools are on the Weather, time and notices page.
dashboard.openWorld: Opens the Weather, time and notices page, with every kind of weather, ready times of day and the latest changes.
dashboard.recent: The latest things staff did from this panel: who did what, to whom and when. It updates by itself.
dashboard.openLog: Opens the full admin log with search and filters, the last 500 actions.
dashboard.shortcuts: Quick links to pages your website role allows. Press the ? beside a link to learn what is there.

dashboard.noneHere: Nobody in this group right now.
